en.hubeali: Hammad Bin Isa, from Hareyz, from Muhammad Bin Muslim who said,
‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about the dog hitting something from the body of the man. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘He should wash the place which it hit him’.
en.sarwar: 2. Hammad ibn ‘Isa has narrated from Hariz from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has said the following:
“I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about a man whose body is polluted because of a dog. He (the Imam) said, ‘He must wash clean the area which has come in contact with a dog.’”
